Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the very first step by stating that "Toongabbie Creek flows into the Hawkesbury River." This is incorrect; Toongabbie Creek is a tributary of the Nepean River, not the Hawkesbury River. Because this initial premise was wrong, all subsequent reasoning by the Planner (including the conclusion that the water flows into the Tasman Sea via the Hawkesbury) was based on false information, leading to the wrong final answer.
